title.en: Put the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Page on the Inquiry, Then Ask Xingtai for the Price
title.zh: 询盘写上柴油60型混凝土泵的页面，价格向邢台确认

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 at /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump: 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 3500 kg. The catalogue sheet is not a price list. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 列在 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump：6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、3500 kg。目录图不是价目表。价格向邢台询盘确认。

h1.en: The Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Order Uses the Printed Page, Not a Guess
h1.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵的订单以已印页面为准

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. The picture on this note is the catalogue layout kept with that model. It is not a price list. Copy the cells that page prints: Model Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132; Diesel Engine (Power) 6105 / 144 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Theoretical output is printed as 35 m³/h. Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, the output you need, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or the site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. The price is not on the page. Confirm the price with Xingtai at /contact. A related note in this set is /blog/buy-electric-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。 这篇配图是该型号留下的目录版式。它不是价目表。抄该页已印的格子：型号 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132、柴油机功率 6105 / 144 kW、理论输送量 35 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.4 m³、输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100、外形尺寸 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、整机重量 3500 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。料斗容积是 0.4 m³。理论输送量印的是 35 m³/h。同时发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、需要的输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。页面上没有价格。价格向邢台询盘确认，用 /contact。本批相关说明见 /blog/buy-electric-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。

heading.en: What to copy from this page

body.en: Name /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump in the subject line. The published row is: Model Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132; Diesel Engine (Power) 6105 / 144 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。已公布的一行是：型号 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132、柴油机功率 6105 / 144 kW、理论输送量 35 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.4 m³、输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100、外形尺寸 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、整机重量 3500 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Power and line size on the same note
heading.zh: 同一封里的动力和管路

body.en: The power cell on this page is diesel, printed as 6105 / 144 kW. Write diesel on the inquiry. Do not replace it with an electric-motor figure from another page. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Leave that cell blank on the order and confirm the size with Xingtai if the job needs pipe.
body.zh: 这一页的动力格是柴油，印的是 6105 / 144 kW。询盘写柴油。不要改成另一页上的电机数字。这一页没有印输送管径。订单上这一格留空；如果工程要配管子，向邢台确认尺寸。

body.en: Confirm the price with Xingtai. The page does not print a list price, a production-day count, a certificate name or a list of export countries. Equipment on these pages ships from Xingtai. The category answers do not claim an overseas warehouse. Write to /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Another page in this set is /blog/buy-electric-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry.
body.zh: 价格向邢台询盘确认。页面不印标价、不印生产天数、不印证书名称，也不印出口国名单。这些页面上的设备从邢台发货。分类说明不声称有海外仓。写信到 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。本批另一篇是 /blog/buy-electric-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。

answer.en: It is not printed on the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵页面上没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Which address do I put on the inquiry?

answer.en: Put /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. That path selects this row. The contact page is /contact.
answer.zh: 写上 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。这条路径选定这一行。联系页是 /contact。

question.en: What weight do I give the forwarder?

answer.en: For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg.
answer.zh: 运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。

question.en: Can I add a certificate or a delivery date?
question.zh: 可以补上证书或交货日期吗？

answer.en: The page does not print a certificate name or a production-day count. Ask Xingtai in the same inquiry, and do not fill those cells yourself.
answer.zh: 页面没有印证书名称，也没有印生产天数。在同一封询盘里问邢台，不要自己填这些格子。

question.en: Which hopper volume is on this row?
question.zh: 这一行的料斗容积是多少？

answer.en: The page prints 0.4 m³. Use that figure with /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump.
answer.zh: 页面印的是 0.4 m³。与 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump 一起使用这个数字。
